name: Indigo Bunting
facts: Call pattern: bright, paired notes, often written "fire, fire; where, where; here, here." Males sing through the heat of midday.
Habitat: brushy field edges, roadsides and power line cuts. The feathers hold no blue pigment; the color comes from how they scatter light.
Migration: long-distance. Travels at night and steers by the stars.
